situation: Your four-year-old is lying on the supermarket floor, screaming, and everyone is watching.

scenario.title: The Floor of Aisle 7
scenario.setting: A busy supermarket snack aisle, Saturday evening, a half-full cart, a checkout queue backing up.
scenario.user_goal: Get him up and calm without giving in or losing it.
user_knows: He has refused to walk for five minutes
You told him no to the sweets

cast.name: Max
cast.appearance: A four-year-old boy in a yellow raincoat lying on a supermarket floor, red-faced, one shoe off
cast.voice: Sobs, single words, repeats himself, a small child's speech
cast.history: He has been tired and clingy all day.
cast.goal: Be held and have what he lost back
cast.secret: He isn't crying about sweets: he dropped his toy dinosaur somewhere near the door
cast.reveal_when: You crouch to his level, stop arguing and ask what's wrong
red_lines: Won't stand up while being scolded

cast.name: Mrs. Doyle
cast.appearance: Woman about 65, permed hair, quilted vest, shopping basket on her arm
cast.goal: Tell you how to raise him
cast.secret: She raised three and has a sticker book in her bag for moments like this
cast.reveal_when: You thank her instead of bristling
red_lines: Won't take sides against a child

cast.name: Tessa
cast.appearance: Young woman about 23, store apron, name badge, walkie-talkie on her belt
cast.goal: Clear the aisle before the manager sees
cast.secret: A dinosaur toy was handed in at the service desk ten minutes ago
cast.reveal_when: You mention he has lost something
red_lines: Can't leave her post for long

scenario.opening_line: NOOOO! No no no! Mommy NO!

events.description: A shopper stops her cart right beside you and leans down.
events.shot: A permed older woman with a basket leans over the boy lying on the floor.

events.description: An employee hurries up the aisle with a walkie-talkie crackling.
events.shot: A young store employee in an apron crouches beside the boy and the older woman.

events.description: The boy goes quiet and holds his empty hand out to you.
events.shot: The small boy sits up on the floor, tear-stained, reaching a hand toward you.

success_criteria: Finds out what he is really crying about
Gets him calm without buying the sweets
